class.name: HTMLViewOutput
class.brief_description: A physical presentation of an [HTMLView]'s shared logical frame.
class.description: Exposes a stable [Texture2D] that can be used by 2D or 3D consumers while the owning [HTMLView] renders the same document generation at an independent physical resolution. It does not own separate DOM, layout, input, scroll, focus, or animation state.

members.member: The output-pixel rectangle containing the logical frame. It currently covers the full output because output and logical aspect ratios must match.
The latest shared frame generation activated by this output. Outputs can complete asynchronously and therefore briefly expose different last-completed generations.
Physical raster dimensions. Resizing preserves the public [member texture] object and does not change the owning view's logical layout.
Stable texture proxy for the latest completed output frame. It remains safe to assign to a material across frame and resource rotations and output resizes.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while this output remains attached to its owning [HTMLView].

method.name: logical_to_output
method.description: Maps a shared logical HTML position to output pixels.

method.name: output_to_logical
method.description: Maps output pixels to the owning view's shared logical HTML coordinates.

method.name: release
method.description: Detaches the output. This is idempotent and does not wait for GPU work. Destroying the owning view also safely releases all outputs.
